name: @qiankunjs/bundler-plugin
description: Bundler plugins for qiankun micro-frontend framework

scripts.build:webpack4: cd ./tests/webpack4 && npm install && pnpm run build
scripts.build:webpack5: cd ./tests/webpack5 && npm install && pnpm run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:webpack4 && pnpm run build:webpack5 && vitest --run
scripts.build: rimraf dist && vite build --config ../../vite.library.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/copy-declarations.mjs src dist/esm && node ../../scripts/copy-declarations.mjs dist/esm dist/cjs && node ./scripts/mark-module-types.mjs

author: Hermanna
